name: DME
summary: DME, also known as bisnormacromerine or as 3,4-dimethoxy-β-hydroxyphenethylamine (β-hydroxy-3,4-DMPEA), is a psychoactive drug of the phenethylamine and BOx families. It is the β-hydroxy derivative of 3,4-dimethoxyphenethylamine (3,4-DMPEA or DMPEA), which is an analogue of mescaline (3,4,5-TMPEA or TMPEA).
summaryZh: DME全稱3,4-二甲氧基-β-羥基苯乙胺是一種有機化合物，分子式C10H15NO3，可作為致幻劑，可看作3,4-二甲氧基苯乙胺的羥基衍生物，最早由亞歷山大·舒爾金合成。

uses.en: It is a research compound studied as a chemical relative of mescaline. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是一種研究用化合物，被視為麥司卡林的化學親戚而受到研究。它沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是一种研究用化合物，被视为麦司卡林的化学亲戚而受到研究。它没有医疗用途。

fact.en: Adding two methyl groups to its nitrogen gives macromerine, an alkaloid found in the cactus Coryphantha macromeris, which is why DME is also called bisnormacromerine.
fact.zh: 在它的氮原子上加兩個甲基，就會得到macromerine，一種存在於仙人掌Coryphantha macromeris中的生物鹼，這也是DME又稱為bisnormacromerine的原因。
fact.zhHans: 在它的氮原子上加两个甲基，就会得到macromerine，一种存在于仙人掌Coryphantha macromeris中的生物碱，这也是DME又称为bisnormacromerine的原因。
